vb_textbox.text: I recommend starting by observing hat size because some have a tall hat and and some have a short hat. In each round, you have to choose between either a short hat or a tall hat. It seems that the rounds happen in stages, and there are high rewards / medium rewards / low rewards. In addition to high hats sometimes being more lucky than short hats and vice versa, I think that the rounds happen in stages of luckiness, so it's not perfect but it's good to go by hat size. In my experience it seemed that there was a group of 10/20 rounds in a high rewards phase and other bunches in a medium or low reward stage. So, just keep trying your best and the rewards will go up again in time.
